runtime_rules: every runtime retry starts physically from the same valid F-KT checkpoint
multiple trials may reuse one checkpoint while its committed revision remains current
checkpoint lineage, revision and bound-time mismatch fail closed inside F-KT before physical execution
a successful commit advances the committed revision and makes the old checkpoint stale
candidate replay does not mutate committed state before F-KT commit
worker-local warm-start data is not checkpoint physical state
checkpoint is a temporary trial object and is not persistent logical-column state
generic_time: F-MR passes [t0,t1] unchanged; no midnight, day, month or year assumption
mass_rule: F-KT hard unrounded trial mass gate remains authoritative; F-MR additionally aggregates unrounded deterministic-backend accounting
